parameters.name: LogicalNetwork
parameters.description: The name of the logical PLC network (human readable string). In the case where the associated device belongs to a different powerline network than the UPA interface, the actual network identifier of the neighboring network is not shown in {{param}}. Rather, only a generic string, e.g. "Network 1", "Network 2", etc is stored here due to security/privacy implications.

parameters.name: EstimatedPLR
parameters.description: Estimated PDU Loss Rate measurement between two devices (i.e. estimated {{units}} of MPDUs that have been received with errors).

parameters.name: MeanEstimatedAtt
parameters.description: Mean estimated attenuation (i.e. channel loss between the local interface and the remote device). It is measured in {{units}}.

parameters.name: SmartRouteIntermediatePLCMAC
parameters.description: Intermediate UPA adapter MAC address of the device that is acting as a relay to increase coverage in mesh scenarios. This is the MAC address of a third UPA device, with which the UPA interface is doing smart repeating in order to transmit data to the associated {{param|MACAddress}} UPA device. {{param}} will be empty when {{param|DirectRoute}} is {{true}}.

parameters.name: DirectRoute
parameters.description: Route status, where {{true}} indicates ''direct'' and {{false}} indicates ''indirect''.

parameters.name: Active
parameters.description: Whether or not this node is currently present in the UPA network. The ability to list inactive nodes is OPTIONAL. If the CPE includes inactive nodes in this table, {{param}} MUST be set to {{false}} for each inactive node. The length of time an inactive node remains listed in this table is a local matter to the CPE.

object.description: This table contains information about PLC connections running between this UPA interface and other UPA devices.
